objects.name: Detection technique coverage: windows-impair-defense-change-win-defender-quick-scan-interval
objects.description: The following analytic detects modifications to the Windows registry that change the Windows Defender Quick Scan Interval. It leverages data from the Endpoint.Registry data model, focusing on changes to the "QuickScanInterval" registry path. This activity is significant because altering the scan interval can impair Windows Defender's ability to detect malware promptly, potentially allowing threats to persist undetected.
